title: World Bloom — Searching for Sunken Shadows — Episode9 Let's Look Together

meta.Event Outline: Mafuyu is now living with Kanade after running away, and all four members of Nightcord at 25:00 are working together again. As they each turn their thoughts to the future, something begins to shift in the Empty SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Thank goodness she stopped crying for now...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(Still... Is she lost...?
More importantly, how did she get here...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Um, so... Where did you come from?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
I was taking a nap...
But when I woke up, I saw that my plushie was gone and started looking for her...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I still don't understand how she got here, but I should try to get her home as soon as possible...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But... How do I actually do that...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(Would I be able to take her back by listening to Untitled...?
No, what if she wounds up somewhere unsafe instead...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Right. She said that she lost her plushie. I should help her find it.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Um, about your plushie...
Do you know where it might've gone?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Does this place not scare you at all...?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Yeah... This place felt scary at first...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: But that music helped me feel better...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Yeah, the music that's playing right now...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: It feels so warm and cozy...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh...
So, did you also hear it when you first woke up?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (If it was louder, then somewhere closer to the source may be where she woke up...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Which means her plushie may also be waiting for us there.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Have you tried looking over there yet?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
This lake's beautiful. It's crystal clear...
But I'm not hearing any songs... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I see...
Then, let's try going over that way.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, also... I'll try seeing if your plushie is somewhere around here. Give me one moment.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm not seeing her plushie anywhere...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(Maybe this isn't the right place...
What if it's closer towards the lake...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Also, she can hear my song coming from the lake. Could there be a music player or something down there...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (What if her plushie fell into the lake...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, I'm okay.
I'm going to keep looking for a little bit longer.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(Going in doesn't seem safe...
But I may also find a clue...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(But what I just saw...
If that was her plushie...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Just a little bit... Oh no...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
S-Sorry.
But I feel like I'm really close.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh...? Where'd that shadow I just saw go...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That's strange. I could've sworn it was just...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: I don't want you to get hurt because of me...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, I'm fine.
I did slip a little just now, but I'll be more careful...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: If she really is in that lake, then there's no point in you looking. I'm probably never gonna get her back...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: There may be a way for us to look inside the lake. Even if she's not here, she could be somewhere else.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: We still don't know where she might be... And I know finding her won't be easy.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But that doesn't mean we can give up.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: If she's in the lake, then we'll find a way to save her.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, let's come up with a plan.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Thank you for everything you've done.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wait, I'm back in my room...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(But how...?
Was that all a dream...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, no... I think I fell asleep just now is all.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
No, I just woke up.
I'll finish those lyrics now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Okay, then I'll also continue working.
Would you mind letting me know when you're finished?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (This is the song I just heard in my dream...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, was I singing just now...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm not sure, but I thought I just heard it in my dream just now...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I was lost in a place that I'd never been, and I was looking for something. I also felt very scared...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: And then I heard this song playing.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That made me feel a little better...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Yeah, the music that's playing right now...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: It feels so warm and cozy...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, that little girl kind of looked like Mafuyu...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mafuyu, do you remember what it was that you were looking for in your dream...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, sorry. It's just that I happened to have a similar dream.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I was helping a little girl look for her plushie...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But if both Mafuyu and that girl felt that they needed to hear my song...)
